# Fit results (generated by scripts/s07_tables.py; code profile v2)

Units: α, β in 1e-4 fm³; γ in 1e-4 fm⁴.  Errors are the full fit errors (statistical ⊕ floating normalisations ⊕
forward-point nuisances/Baldin ⊕ truncation covariance where included).  "*" = fixed input (NNLO value).
Main configuration: F2 = MAIN database (all region-L data, E ≤ 150 MeV, minus the 3σ outlier(s) MAIN_DROP = ['OlmosdeLeon2001_029'])
+ GHP forward points (E ≤ 145 MeV, correlated nuisances), no Baldin penalty, spin polarisabilities at NNLO,
EFT truncation covariance (scheme B, LEC-matched).  "d_all" = main database; "d_allpts" = all points incl. the outlier.
